page.overview:
What is Order's Supreme Council?

The Order's Supreme Council was an esteemed body of the Order of the Flaming Rose consisting of mostly honored knights, masters and a few priests of the Eternal Fire, as well as the head of whole brotherhood - the Grandmaster.

As of , the conclave swore fealty to King Radovid V of Redania and moved to the city of Roggeven, where they oversaw the construction of Castle Barienmurg.
